The FloPlast MiniFlo 76mm half round stop end outlet is a vital component for efficient rainwater drainage systems. This black uPVC fitting connects a MiniFlo gutter to a 50mm downpipe and provides a secure seal for the gutter end. It is ideal for smaller structures such as garages, sheds, summer houses, and various garden buildings. Manufactured from durable uPVC for longevity, it features pre-lubricated gutter seals and a pre-fitted retaining clip for straightforward installation and a watertight connection. This low maintenance design offers a reliable solution for rainwater management.
